rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a female host welcoming or entertaining guests, especially in a home or social setting.

example.english: The hostess was very welcoming and greeted us herself yesterday.
example.traditional: 噚日嗰位女主人好熱情，親自招呼我哋。
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 go2 wai6 neoi5 zyu2 jan4 hou2 jit6 cing4 can1 zi6 ziu1 fu1 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this when the female hostess is the owner or person running an inn, guesthouse, or other establishment.

example.english: The hostess at that inn was very friendly and even carried our luggage herself.
example.traditional: 嗰間客棧嘅老闆娘好好人，仲親自幫我哋拎行李。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 haak3 zaan2 ge3 lou5 baan2 noeng4 hou2 hou2 jan4 zung6 can1 zi6 bong1 ngo5 dei6 ling1 hang4 lei5
